{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Remove refunded orders — they are not successful conversions
# The question asks for conversion rate, which should only include completed orders
# So we filter out refunded ones
df_clean = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check: are the conversion rates now computed only on completed orders?
conversion_rate_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conversion_rate_paid_search = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference (email minus paid_search)
difference = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

print(f"Conversion rate (email): {conversion_rate_email}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {conversion_rate_paid_search}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
